10. An astronaut in a space capsule orbiting the earth experiences weightlessness. Why? [2)

The centripetal force necessary to keep the space-ship in an orbit around the earth is provided by the gravitational force between the earth and the spaceship. Hence, the only force of gravity that an astronaut in an orbiting space-ship experiences is that which is due to the gravitational force exerted by the space ship. But the space-ship is small, this force is negligibly small and the astronaut doesn't experience any gravity. Hence, the astronaut experiences a feeling of weightlessness.
